instructions: Complete the summary below. Write NO MORE THAN TWO WORDS AND/OR A NUMBER for each answer.
word_limit: NO MORE THAN TWO WORDS AND/OR A NUMBER
stem_block:
HOW SEED REACHES THE STORE

Collections kept with future plant breeding in mind go back to the 1920s, when breeders saw older varieties vanishing from farms; one collection made then is still being drawn on today, and it is a collection of (31) ........

In the field, a team is told to gather seed from a minimum of (32) ........ plants and to leave at least four-fifths of the ripe seed behind. Drying is deliberately slow, because seed that dries too quickly on the surface forms a (33) ........ and the moisture is then locked in. A worn gasket lets water back in: the manuals allow one or two per cent, but in the speaker's own store the moisture climbed back by (34) ........ per cent over a season.

A sample is germinated before anything is put away, and the whole collection goes back to the field team if fewer than (35) ........ per cent of the seeds grow. After that the test is repeated every (36) ........ years in the banks the speaker has worked in, although each one uses up seed.

items.prompt: one collection made then is still being drawn on today, and it is a collection of (31) ........
items.evidence: everybody assumes it must be wheat, but it is barley
items.explanation: One of the collections made in the twenties is still in use; the speaker says everyone assumes it must be wheat, but it is barley.

yeniden_uretim.eski_cerceve: Seed was first stored with future plant breeding in mind in the (31) ........
yeniden_uretim.neden_elendi: Bosluk tohum bankaciliginin baslangic onyilini soruyordu; 1920'ler tarihsel genel bilgi oldugu icin konusma duyulmadan 3/3 turda dolduruldu.
yeniden_uretim.ne_degisti: Recete 2+3: tarih artik cerceve icinde VERILIYOR, bosluk konusmanin kendi sectigi bir ayrintiya tasindi. Senaryoda tur 1'in ikinci cumlesine yan cumlecik sigdirildi: 'one collection made in those years is still being drawn on today, and everybody assumes it must be wheat, but it is barley.' Dunyanin bekledigi deger (bugday) sesli celdirici oldu, cevap arpa. Cumle/tur sayisi degismedi.

items.prompt: a team is told to gather seed from a minimum of (32) ........ plants
items.evidence: the guidance is to sample from at least a hundred plants
items.explanation: Fifty plants is the figure in the older manuals; the modelling done since points to a hundred plants as the working minimum.

yeniden_uretim.eski_cerceve: a team is told to gather seed from a minimum of (32) ........ plants
yeniden_uretim.neden_elendi: Elli bitki, tohum toplama protokollerinin ders kitabi alt siniri; konusma duyulmadan 3/3 turda yazildi.
yeniden_uretim.ne_degisti: Recete 2: cevap noktasi ayni kaldi, senaryodaki deger yerinde degistirildi. Tur 2 'at least fifty plants' -> 'at least a hundred plants'; tur 3'teki sesli rakip de 'thirty plants quoted' -> 'fifty plants quoted' oldu, yani dunyanin bekledigi elli artik celdirici. Cerceve metni degismedi.

items.prompt: seed that dries too quickly on the surface forms a (33) ........ and the moisture is then locked in
items.evidence: seed dried too quickly on the outside forms a hard skin that traps water inside
items.explanation: Drying is deliberately slow: seed that dries quickly forms a hard skin on the outside and the water stays locked in.

items.prompt: in the speaker's own store the moisture climbed back by (34) ........ per cent over a season
items.evidence: in our own store we have measured six
items.distractor_used: one or two per cent (the manual figure)
items.explanation: The manuals allow a climb of one or two per cent over a season, but the speaker says that in her own store a jar with a poor gasket let the moisture climb back by six per cent.

items.prompt: the whole collection goes back to the field team if fewer than (35) ........ per cent of the seeds grow
items.evidence: if fewer than eighty-five per cent come up, the collection is not accepted
items.explanation: The threshold the speaker learned was seventy-five per cent; it has since been raised to eighty-five per cent.

items.prompt: After that the test is repeated every (36) ........ years in the banks the speaker has worked in, although each one uses up seed.
items.evidence: the banks I have worked in have stretched the gap to fifteen
items.distractor_used: ten years (the figure printed in the standards)
items.explanation: Ten years is the figure printed in the standards; because each test takes two hundred seeds, the banks the speaker has worked in have stretched the gap to fifteen years.

yeniden_uretim.eski_cerceve: After that the test is repeated every (36) ........ years, although each one uses up seed.
yeniden_uretim.neden_elendi: On yil, tohum canlilik testinin bilinen standart araligi; konusma duyulmadan 3/3 turda yazildi.
yeniden_uretim.ne_degisti: Recete 2+3: cevap noktasi ayni, senaryodaki deger yerinde degisti. Tur 7 artik 'the figure printed in the standards is ten years. That is the figure in print, but the banks I have worked in have stretched the gap to fifteen' diyor; on yil sesli celdirici oldu. Cerceve 'in the banks the speaker has worked in' diyerek hangi degerin istendigini isaretliyor ama sayiyi vermiyor.
